Supplemental body evidence reports compiled planner and CLI checks preserving authored rows and excluding unauthenticated deferred inventory; production code is unchanged since that tested revision. | | **Evidence reviewed** | 8 items | Current main still contains the reported overwrite: The current-main helper copies root providers, then assigns generated providers under the same IDs before planning, replacing the authored provider object.
Separate planning preserves authorship: Generated recovery uses plugin catalogs separately; the root merge retains existing root declarations and reapplies normalization and managed-secret enforcement. Explicit replace still bypasses preservation.
Membership filtering stays inside the catalog boundary: Ownership and endpoint filtering precede the deferred-plugin authentication check. ModelRegistry supplies existing AuthStorage and configured-key predicates; this changes inventory membership without adding request authority or a Codex dependency. | | **Findings** | None | None. | | **Security** | None | None. | ## How this fits together OpenClaw combines manually declared models with plugin-generated inventory to populate model lists and agent registries. Catalog planning maintains those sources, while registry loading decides which generated entries are currently eligible. ```mermaid flowchart TD A[Manual model declarations] --> C[Catalog planning] B[Generated plugin inventory] --> C C --> D[Separate root and generated catalogs] D --> E[Registry loading] F[Current ownership endpoints and authentication] --> E E --> G[Model lists and agent registry] ``` ## Before merge None.

Thanks @obviyus!

**Proof:** Compiled models-list checks and independent acceptance verify that refresh keeps manual models and that deferred generated inventory requires current authentication.

- **Bug:** Refresh hid a manual DeepSeek model; a deferred LM Studio cache could list an implicit model without current credentials.
- **Fix:** Preserve authored roots separately from generated catalogs, with shared ownership, endpoint, and current-authentication checks.

| Before | After |
| --- | --- |
| DeepSeek refresh reduced four models to three | All four remain, including the authored name and context |
| Deferred cache listed a model without current authentication | Implicit rows stay absent; authenticated and authored controls still work |

Exact-head local review is clean at B with proof A. Required CI run 34249831444 passed on attempt 2. Attempt 1's Gateway-fixture startup timeout remains in the evidence; the failed jobs recovered through the existing GitHub-runner retry path, with no test, timeout, source, or workflow change. The assertion-count failure from the preceding revision was corrected separately. No unrelated-CI exception was used.

The procedural owner-review hold for the root-authorship test was resolved by the [recorded exact-head approval](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/142302#issuecomment-5588621689). Code, security, proof, and CI gates remained enforced. Compiled runtime evidence retains its original build/source identity; standalone installation and live-provider behavior are outside this proof.
